YouTuber Dhruv Rathee released after claiming he was kidnapped

YouTuber Dhruv Rathee was detained by police and subsequently released; Rathee said he was kidnapped rather than legally detained and asserted that he did not sign any bond or undertaking, while police released him under unspecified conditions.
